function.description: Use this structured runtime API for mobility groups and mobility peers, including peer lists, peer counts, tunnel or path status, encryption, membership, and owning-controller questions. Prefer it over Knowledge Base for current operational mobility data. `networkDeviceId` identifies only the owning managed WLC and must be its canonical UUID; resolve an explicitly named owner/controller hostname or management IP first, then pass that UUID. IPs that identify mobility peers or tunnel endpoints are `mobilityPeers[].peerIp` or `mobilityPeers[].privateIpAddress` response fields, not `networkDeviceId`. For a peer-IP-only request, call with no arguments, inspect all returned mobility groups, and filter their nested `mobilityPeers` records. Never validate or resolve a peer IP as a managed device, never call `get_device_details` for the peer IP, and never pass it as `networkDeviceId`. Unmanaged peers can legitimately have `peerNetworkDeviceId=UNKNOWN`. Do not route current mobility-peer questions to Knowledge Base or answer that data is unavailable before calling this API.
function.name: api_getMobilityGroups

networkDeviceId.description: Optional canonical managed WLC UUID used to select the owning controller's mobility group. Resolve a user-supplied owning-controller hostname or management IP to this UUID first. This value is never a mobility peer IP or tunnel endpoint. When the prompt supplies only peer IPs, omit this parameter and filter the returned mobilityPeers[].peerIp/privateIpAddress fields.

response.description: Self Mobility group details and Peer details.

dataLinkEncryption.description: A secure link in which data is encrypted using CAPWAP DTLS protocol can be established between two controllers. This value will be applied to all peers during POST operation.

macAddress.description: Device mobility MAC Address. Allowed formats are:0a0b.0c01.0211, 0a0b0c010211, 0a:0b:0c:01:02:11

mobilityGroupName.description: Self device Group Name. Must be alphanumeric without {!,<,space,?/'} and maximum of 31 characters.

mobilityPeers.description: Peer details. Maximum 24 peers are allowed.

dataLinkEncryption.description: A secure link in which data is encrypted using CAPWAP DTLS protocol can be established between two controllers.

deviceSeries.description: Peer device mobility belongs to AireOS or IOX-XE family. 0 - indicates AireOS and 1 - indicates C9800.

hashKey.description: SSC hash string must be 40 characters.

memberMacAddress.description: Peer device mobility MAC Address.  Allowed formats are:0a0b.0c01.0211, 0a0b0c010211, 0a:0b:0c:01:02:11

mobilityGroupName.description: Peer device mobility group Name. Must be alphanumeric without {!,<,space,?/'} and maximum of 31 characters.

peerNetworkDeviceId.description: Peer device Id. The possible values are UNKNOWN or valid UUID of Network device ID. UNKNOWN represents out of band device which is not managed internally. Valid UUID represents WLC network device ID.

status.description: Possible values are - Control and Data Path Down, Data Path Down, Control Path Down, UP.

networkDeviceId.description: Obtain the network device ID value by using the API call GET: /dna/intent/api/v1/network-device/ip-address/${ipAddress}.
